description: Selection of an institution for Revamping Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to execute the procurement process for selecting an institution to revamp the Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, expressions of interest have been invited for the relevant procurement following the two-stage bidding procurement procedure, and four (04) institutions have submitted expressions of interest. Following the evaluation process of the said expressions of interest, proposals have been invited from Giesecke & Devrient Asia Pacific Limited, Hong Kong, which fulfilled the relevant qualifications as per the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee. After evaluating the technical and financial proposals submitted by the said institution, the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee has recommended that the procurement for the revamping the Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka be awarded to the said institution. Based on the said recommendation, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the relevant procurement, to Giesecke & Devrient Asia Pacific Limited, Hong Kong, was approved by the Cabinet.
